address: 13, Alley 1, Lane 229, Linsen Road, East District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan
bio: A house with over 50 years of history has morphed into this airy, minimalist venue serving traditional Taiwanese fare and well-curated local teas. Period terrazzo floor tiles and wrought iron railings are juxtaposed with a white granite counter and mid-century modern furniture for an eclectic feel. Try stir-fried oyster and tofu with fermented black beans, or three-cup chicken with aged huadiao wine. It would be a crime to miss the tea menu.
